body:
Dear Hoosier Republicans, No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-tk/) _**Focus on Affordability**_ Dear Hoosier Republicans,From announcing a gas tax holiday to provide immediate relief at the pump, to signing landmark legislation that holds utilities accountable and puts ratepayers first, to investing $200 million to expand access to affordable child care and reduce waitlists, Governor Mike Braun has made affordability his administration's top priority. These are practical steps aimed at easing the pressure working families feel every day, and they exemplify the kind of results-driven leadership Hoosiers deserve.With the November election approaching quickly, the stakes for our state couldn't be clearer. The progress being made to rein in costs and put Hoosiers first depends on strong, conservative leadership and a commitment to seeing these reforms through. This election will determine whether Indiana continues on this path of affordability and accountability or risks reversing course. Now is the time to get involved, stay engaged, and help ensure that leadership focused on real results continues moving our state forward.As always, thank you for being a part of our team, and please feel free to reach out if there's any way I can be of assistance.Yours in service, Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman _**Governor Braun Announces $200 Million Investment to Expand Child Care Affordability and Reduce Waitlists**_ Governor Mike Braun announced a $200 million investment to expand access to affordable child care, aimed at reducing waitlists and supporting working families across Indiana. The funding will allow the state to reopen enrollment in the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF) program and add 14,000 more children, prioritizing young kids and families with the greatest needs."When parents have access to reliable, affordable child care, they can pursue better jobs, gain new skills, and build stronger futures. And this investment isn't just for one year. It marks the start of a sustained commitment to keeping care affordable and giving families long-term confidence that the support they count on will remain in place. This investment strengthens our workforce while expanding opportunity for families." \- Governor Braun via a [press release](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-r/) **_Gov. Mike Braun Takes Action to Lower Energy Prices, Make Life More Affordable for Hoosier Families_** Governor Mike Braun signed HEA 1002, a landmark piece of legislation that ends guaranteed returns for utilities and requires that they meet performance standards."Affordability is this administration's top priority, and high electricity prices have placed a major burden on Hoosiers' wallets. I've taken action to put affordability for Hoosiers above profits for utilities, and this new law requiring utilities to meet performance benchmarks based on affordability and accountability is a big step forward for affordability."\- Governor Braun via a [press release](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-y/) [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-j/) [Subscribe to The Braun Briefing!](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-t/) If you want to stay up to date with everything happening in the Governor's office, don't miss out, subscribe today! _**Chairwoman's County Visits: 36**_ **Cass County** **Kosciusko** **County** **Orange** **County** **Spencer** **County** **Whitley County** **Steuben County** **Madison County** **Blackford County** **Warren County** **Lawrence County** _**Chairman's Award Recipients**_ **Mike Roos** Mike Roos is a lifelong Spencer County resident whose decades of service reflect a deep commitment to his community and the Republican Party. From roles on the County Council, township board, and Sheriff's Merit Board to his work as a precinct committeeman and state convention delegate, Mike has led with humility, consistency, and a strong sense of responsibility. A farmer and trusted community member, his steady, behind-the-scenes leadership and tireless volunteerism have helped strengthen both his county and the party for generations to come. **Jack Hinkle** Jack Hinkle is a dedicated grassroots leader whose years of service to Orange County reflect a deep commitment to both his community and the Republican Party. From his start as a precinct committeeman to his leadership as county chairman and continued service on the County Council, Jack has worked tirelessly to support candidates, strengthen the local party, and deliver results. **Bob Hiday** Bob Hiday has dedicated more than five decades to serving his community and the Republican Party, exemplifying service leadership. From his time as a precinct committeeman and local elected official to his service on school boards, commissions, and as a volunteer firefighter, Bob has played a key role in strengthening Fortville and Hancock County. His lifelong commitment to public service, faith, and community has left a lasting impact on the people and institutions he serves. **Sandy Garcia** Sandy Garcia has been a cornerstone of the Wells County Republican Party for more than three decades, known for her leadership, warmth, and tireless dedication to others. From her early days in serving as Republican Women's president to her years as Vice Chair, she has mentored candidates, organized countless events, and built lasting relationships throughout her community. Sandy has created a legacy defined by friendship, leadership, and an unwavering service to her community and party. **John Schneider** Since arriving in Indiana, John Schneider has used his talent, platform, and voice to strengthen the Republican Party and support candidates across the state. John brings heart and conviction to everything he does, and his generosity, commitment to conservative values, and willingness to step up and serve have quickly made him a valued part of Indiana's Republican community. **2026 State Convention** [Click Here for More Information](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-i/) [Confirmed Delegate Registration](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-d/) [Delegate Fees paid by Parties/Organization](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-h/) [Guest (Non-Delegate) Registration](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-k/) _**Indiana GOP is Hiring Interns for the Spring & Summer**_ **📱 _News You Can Use_ ** **Governor Mike Braun**** **[traveled](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-u/) across Indiana last week, with stops in Summitville, Greenfield, Rushville, Liberty, Connersville, Terre Haute, Delphi, Huntington, and Aurora to highlight Indiana's small businesses, economic development, hundreds of new Hoosier high-wage jobs, and the local leaders and community institutions helping move Indiana forward.**Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith** [met](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-b/) with Taiwan's representative to the United States to discuss a multi-billion-dollar agreement to purchase Indiana corn and soybeans. Beckwith said the partnership will continue to support trade and benefit both Indiana and Taiwan.**Secretary Diego Morales **[announced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-n/) the start of early voting across Indiana for the upcoming May primary election, encouraging Hoosiers to take advantage of in-person absentee voting options. Morales also reminded voters to check their registration, bring a valid photo ID, and make a plan to participate in the election.**Treasurer Daniel Elliott **[met](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-p/) with local leaders in Clinton, Carroll, and White counties to discuss community needs and how his office can continue supporting Hoosiers across the state.**Attorney General Todd Rokita**[celebrated](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-x/) a verdict declaring Live Nation Entertainment Inc. to be a monopolist in its concert and ticketing dealings, saying, "This verdict sends a clear message: no company is too big to play by the rules. Live Nation must now provide meaningful relief to fans, artists and venues who have paid the price for its anticompetitive practices."**Senator Todd Young**[co-introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-m/)** ** the _Title X Abortion Provider Prohibition Act_ to ban federal Title X family-planning grants from going to any entity (like Planned Parenthood) that performs abortions or funds abortion providers, saying, "Title X was designed to provide moms and children with necessary family planning services, not fund abortions. This legislation will protect life and ensure taxpayer dollars are protected from taking innocent lives."**Senator Jim Banks** was [appointed](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-c/)** ** Chairman of the Subcommittee on Employment and Workplace Safety on the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) Committee, saying, "I'm grateful for this opportunity to help more workers get the training they need and support American manufacturing. Rebuilding our industry starts with supporting the people who keep this country running and making sure working Americans can get ahead."**Congressman Rudy Yakym **[led](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-q/) a bipartisan letter urging Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Kennedy and Administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Mehmet Oz, to take action on improving Medicare coverage for FDA-designated breakthrough medical devices. The letter was signed by 82 Members of Congress and received support from leading health and industry organizations.**Congressman Marlin Stutzman**[co-introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-a/) the _Fostering the Use of Technology to Uphold Regulatory Effectiveness in Supervision (FUTURES) Act_. The legislation aims to modernize technology systems within federal agencies responsible for regulating banks and credit unions, enhancing their capacity for effective supervision and oversight.**Congressman Jim Baird **[introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-f/) the _Tech Diplomacy Training Act_ to ensure all Foreign Service officers receive training on Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) concepts prior to being stationed abroad.**Congresswoman Victoria Spartz**[joined](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-z/) the NASA team and congressional colleagues for the launch of Artemis II.**Congressman Jefferson Shreve **[joined](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-e/) the House Committee on Appropriations, saying, "It is an honor to join the House Committee on Appropriations. The committee has a long-standing history of careful stewardship of taxpayer dollars and rigorous oversight of federal spending. As the first Indiana Republican to serve on this committee in thirty years, I'm ready to go to work for Hoosiers. I'm grateful for Chairman Cole's trust and leadership." **Congressman Mark Messmer **[honored](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-s/) former prisoners of war, recognizing their courage, service, and sacrifice in defense of the nation.**Congresswoman Erin Houchin**[celebrated](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-g/) House passage of _[S. 98, the Rural Broadband Protection Act](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-adkktjl-hhlljjcji-w/)_. Rep. Houchin sponsored the House companion bill, which passed the House unanimously last year, and the Senate version was led by Senator Shelley Moore Capito (R-WV). The bipartisan legislation strengthens accountability in federal broadband programs and helps ensure taxpayer dollars reach rural communities that need internet access. **_Upcoming Events_****April _**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Parler_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by_ _Parler_ _._
---
| Jim Jordan After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Friend! | | Friend,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

## Press Dinner Shooter's Manifesto Released
Suspected White House Correspondents' Dinner shooter Cole Allen [sent a manifesto to his family](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAQgJ9GOwwOKFpQ_M12-7dXGhbGlQuCgXHNvv2Fy-Ve4LpJvszk--bjvtyNDz4-_5sdNa1piXiVgESYl3KWAy2V3US_YqF0bZ5wS-cCHEbGJQO1OOPDe5Gt0ysioGhR90opmCQo0W7aWsX5jOMwDVwM02gHM6y9HGfgD_WAufW6XuMSVM-5FNBNCAOXvZ2FklKIuZEcnaeUu8_kI224hnd6Ye5s2tugN6KjNOJfA7cGbtd1dfZRakXlDdzqWEF1Z1s6CzKbcsZypOgwUmHOx4iZ_eSy31zmkIwPdbvN2h2XD8GXUTWSP3fjw7cA_elrLw1fAQAA__8yuoMJ) minutes before the attack, outlining plans to target administration officials from highest to lowest. Allen said in his writings that he would use "[buckshot](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQRp_GdBOZwYmhcHEbutx2S-TAGBz5B-EhiLdfscW-wHZHGulozvf1HJ7WB5_m_zaSYZeHREcJxEzbUPay0sgl2uQdFc7H4pmWvA8o8QFSAephsj6cg6om44iQmopMrbXGVqFuqsWgfk1tp60bO8S768iOrp6wu7fYulrpypvLJhXqWkrV4K0lvEtVj12jlWqaTihJk-e83d7ZJ17IhTN_aLuNOVbBLMxrEc0_gb3APp1rLnydBPaXWGAv1cUX7QWuPoH9sYwTzHuKNsGYA4ENgRIUSgw2sQfe9rjCbzpwBmejDye898LwIpc3grxS8mkW2FebmdbDh-DLQwsl52h9-HmR_7Trx-B3AAAA___1O4zr) rather than slugs" to "minimize casualties," but added, _" I would still go through most everyone here to get to the targets if it were absolutely necessary ... but I really hope it doesn't come to that."_ While not mentioning the Correspondents' Dinner by name, Allen wrote that the lack of security at the hotel was "insane," noting that security was "all outside, focused on protestors and current arrivals" and that "no one thought about what happens if someone checks in the day before." Allen signed the document to his family as "Cole 'coldForce' '[Friendly Federal Assassin](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb_G3rDwA4wZGLpkS9eOFrafAy0GC54T5e-rRP2D7lf33nO-rtPVhRjS7dPtaGnLU8JHjUiEZapnPXChursUNqyUHz4Q-nxOwGFgXDLQ0-pCfE6yXe2GCChatL3WGkYJWrTezkYoLgbljJgXnOfBGMeFMKNSenZStsG-2rgE3XMuBXQjguKyX4zQUgphGslxDZRL951DIo9bfOY7lm7JexutJzpqIz4auDRwOX-6F0H3dD7nV6KBy_s28_msyJZcCtYjpxUTVbaGlLCwP1LWK6Gh12rsPO2xLXY9HiHGUAfdSH7bXYjvVfqXqruF3wAAAP__az994w)' Allen."
## London Marathon Winner Breaks 2-Hour Mark
Kenya's Sabastian Sawe became the first person to officially record a [sub-two-hour marathon](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOnDAQBOCnMZ1PZu3DXEGRhu5PmxL58PKzibGRd--se_uIvELa-aTRaH59LV-BEuXvn-HASbayZGycUATrwi8-cRU-QqYNWUrbSXAvrwUMDNo4DX6JgdJncV2cNkRA2-HUe-9hdOBtt08BrBkDbj3en8a6-Ixx9DjccfC9Cduzo-lqMw58b4yzcBsR7sb168N656x9KGcwkpR6-10oy45b-pQ31ttaji5Nu8jJyv5QMCuYW2s35DNfqGAu6XOctLKCWWpY_4QcN8IUFcwspX4UzIuCma7AjffH6MfhsvAMLBSy5tBQN8qsU8mxZH2EGmQvWVdcS426Z9EbZeJdg97Lq3JXp3g2Sol48MqZ7yNQ-jdW_uvh9wR_AwAA__-dxJE7) on Sunday, winning the London Marathon with a time of one hour, 59 minutes, and 30 seconds. That historic milestone belonged to Sawe alone for [only 11 seconds](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuxCAURE9jd6zwBxtTUKTZbtOmtH7gsybCYAFea28fOVdIORppNO99PZYHhhjS8xM3Ms3nJdFZI7VGZalH3cm2umEKnmrL5xoarflYgMPEuGSgFochvhfZO-OJgERPZlBKwSxBiX41ToAXo1AkHAoiPXrSdpST9ugntHMfzLXGJaiBcyngNhOMXA5WCyWlELqTnFxoudx-ckhtJR_f-UXlZvPWR7O2ttdOfHRw7-CO-wVwVVcoLdhIHdw3LNjWnFghm4tjFU9iMSeXEzuSo8Lamdmaj1LZLOcBtZ659oMm7hxY9BbF9O3EpCbsi3H7GWIMdVKd5M8NQ_w70_5l8GXgNwAA__9saIVr), as Ethiopia's Yomif Kejelcha, running in his first marathon, finished in 1:59.41. Sawe broke the previous men's marathon record by a massive [65 seconds](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAYBOCnsTcs_ENMPDB08ZauHS0MvwMthgj-BOXtK_cVOn-60-m-buvNhBjS_dMcqGnPa8JWIxJhWeuzPtBSPUwKO1bKzQdCn58rcJgYlwzU6kyI71X2Tu-IgKJHPSql4CpBid7rDffJ7gI5bPNFyQ2dmIU119kJYTcr-qDPNi5BjZxLAcMV4cLlaGehpBRi7iRHFyiX4TuHRB73-M4vLIPNRx-1J3rUTnx0sHSwtNYG107qYMHUwVJNQ1YPUz1WBsznZ2GHKT-sIlFId1bQ5uKYIRZzcjmdasjnM2yYmmYpRjX2RbtHCzGGOqlO8vthQvybQP_67aXhNwAA__9pN4JA) after covering the second half of the race in 59:01 en route to retaining the London Marathon title. Eliud Kipchoge, another Kenyan, recorded an unofficial sub-two-hour marathon in 2019 for an event in Vienna specifically tailored for the feat.
## Glacier Stalls Everest's Spring Season
Hundreds of climbers are stuck at Mount Everest's base camp, [unable to begin their ascent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO2yAUxfGngQ0LX7CxB4Yu3tK1o0XgOtBgE8F1rLx9lb7CNx_pJ53_n9t6cymn4_Hb7WhpK-uBV8tIhHVtZ3uhp7a7I23YqFwxEcZyriBhFFILMGtwKX9WzYPdEAEVR9sbY2DSYBSPFqegwuAH7bWcnbvPGsdRuXlScghquPNkv5rUYHoptYJuQhik7v2sjNZKzUxLDIlK7f6WdFDELX_KG2vny86zjUSvxtQvBguD5bquzpX83Rgs3zMMFh_P4yke2fmEVdxz8c8majkJBb6xYiPRj6pXgzTQRdozrza8rpRzaqNhWj52l_6bnH4U6W3hXwAAAP__WZF7HA) as a 100-foot block of unstable glacial ice seals off the route up the Nepalese side. The ice sits in the notorious Khumbu Icefall, where Sherpa "icefall doctors" normally fix ropes and ladders. After two weeks searching for a workaround, they [declared the route unsafe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DEPmzAQBeBfA5uROV9wGDx0YUvXjsiYI1xjcGQfoPz7KlX_Qff3PT29X4_x4Tny_vzpN3KypHGnq0QSoTyWo7wpSNn8zgsVSdfKQms6RtDQKY0K7Dh7jp8R69ktRECmJtdaa-GOYE29uradOt3dfH8PYAnN3M-hW2hBRLoBdjW7b5tGsK3WaKC5E9w0tqE3FtGYvkJNM0vKze_Eu6y0xE86KTchbXV0q8i7VOZHBUMFw3VdDZ2UqcjKLyrfUAXDlMm_eH-qzZfCJykOpAplH9QUU3gVtaVjF_WPqpwOIVUk-33-Mmy1CpG3iXKpYKizm98Xx8ilsxXq5-Y5_t0j_3Xi6eBPAAAA__-aS4iq) on Friday. Adding to the worries, a U.N.-backed flood [warning system](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL8GOpBZm7MpXKShu7QpkcHLeRODT_Zy6P4-Ir-QbqQZzWje1326O4q0Pz7dhpbXNO14lojMmKdylCcuXDa304qF0xmIMaRjAgG3RqgG9OQdxfekam9XREBZo-201mAUaFkHa7QU87zOvehR9k4YwN4YHObODODR12SvNqFAd0IoCa1B6IXqlkFqpaQcKiXQE6fcfifaOeAa3-mFuV3SVkcbmJ-lkh8VjBWM53m2bxdSutwKxutOBaPLTEvES3JIR3G7L02m8tNsR2RqNoqR0t74FKPLDUgwXa8B2sBbrLP1z_NKlJuulHhsjuLfOv8L2cvCbwAAAP__fyGAkQ) for the region's swollen glacial lakes has fallen into disrepair, with siren towers rusting and batteries stolen. Nepal hiked permit fees to $15,000 this year, but demand stayed strong. The delay now risks dangerous traffic jams at the summit once the May weather window opens.

Politics are heating up as the midterms approach. The most interesting and important candidate in the country might be Seth Bodnar.
Who the heck is Seth Bodnar and why is he so pivotal? He is the former President of the University of Montana who in February stepped down to run for U.S. Senate as an Independent.
"As a father, I just couldn't sit by and watch our country become more divided and dysfunctional. I believe we deserve better leadership than we're getting. So I decided to run for Senate."
This sounds like something lots of candidates might say, but Seth has demonstrated his patriotism over decades of service. He went to West Point and graduated first in his class (!!) on the way to becoming a Rhodes Scholar. He commanded an Airborne Special Forces squadron in Iraq, jumping out of planes in hostile territory over multiple deployments. He was basically a superhero. Seth remains in the National Guard Reserve to this day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7545d75-cd7c-443e-bab5-ad9bb0ca94c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"Watching our members of Congress go on vacation while TSA workers weren't getting paid is an example of subpar leadership. At West Point, we were taught that leaders eat last, and if there's not enough food you don't eat. Unfortunately, our current leaders often think they should eat first." I bet many Americans would agree with that sentiment.
After returning from war, Seth became an executive at GE before becoming President of the University of Montana. "My wife is from Montana, and we have 3 kids together." He served very successfully for 8 years before stepping away to run for the Senate in February.
In his first month, his campaign raised almost $1.4 million, more than every other candidate in the race, Republicans and Democrats combined(!!!). His endorsers include Jon Tester, who represented Montana in the Senate for years, as well as the former head of the state Republican party. He is building bridges in a state that has an enormous independent streak.
"When I talk to Montanans, they don't think about politics day-to-day as much as they do how to keep their car working, getting food on the table for their kids, making sure their crop will make it to market this year, and that their kids will stay in the state instead of going away. They're tired of people heading to Washington and then just putting on a jersey once they get there."
You can see why Seth is such a compelling figure. The U.S. Senate could essentially be deadlocked in January, which means that an Independent Senator could be profoundly influential as a tiebreaking vote or a figure who could work with either side. The fact that he could come out of Montana - no one's idea of a battleground - is also groundbreaking. Even though Montana only has 1.1 million people, every Senate vote is equal. I've [donated](https://substack.com/redirect/30a34e5d-69cd-4a68-8a3d-ead5ab16f0eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to support Seth and I hope you consider doing so as well.
"Your money goes farther in a place like Montana where we can effectively reach out and talk to voters. When I get to the Senate, I'm not going to have a 'D' or an 'R' on my jacket, but instead an 'M' for the people of Montana. I've already pledged not to caucus with either party, but I'm excited to work with other Senators who want to solve problems for the people."
For my interview of Seth Bodnar on the podcast, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/aa72ab88-17a4-4201-8fee-9dd0f0f208da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and for his website click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/e71c99f2-85b9-47e9-b83c-f6491305882d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The U.S. Senate could essentially be deadlocked in January, which means that an Independent Senator could be profoundly influential as a tiebreaking vote or a figure who could work with either side. The fact that he could come out of Montana - no one's idea of a battleground - is also groundbreaking. Even though Montana only has 1.1 million people, every Senate vote is equal. I've to support Seth and I hope you consider doing so as well. "Your money goes farther in a place like Montana where we can effectively reach out and talk to voters. When I get to the Senate, I'm not going to have a 'D' or an 'R' on my jacket, but instead an 'M' for the people of Montana. I've already pledged not to caucus with either party, but I'm excited to work with other Senators who want to solve problems for the people." For my interview of Seth Bodnar on the podcast, click and for his website click . For a limited time only you can get 6 months** off your mobile bill through April 30. You read that right. Email and use my name to collect what is objectively an absolutely boffo value that will help you save for your family and your future. body:
Peter, when I was younger, my dad told me that if you want to succeed, you have to dress the part.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1182%2E124072%2EnMtHqx)
| | | |
---
Peter,

I love meeting North Carolinians and talking with folks directly – but I also love unwinding at home, sitting down with a good science fiction novel and spending time with my family.
When my time was up as Governor, I thought I was ready to hang up my coat and tie for good.

**But things change. Over the past year, I’ve seen the worsening chaos and horrors coming out of Washington DC just like you have, and I knew I had to run for Senate.**
This election was too important – North Carolina was too important – to leave anything to chance.

The GOP thinks they can buy this Senate seat with super PAC money and megadonors. **They’re pouring tens of millions into North Carolina to defeat me, and now, a recent poll shows this race statistically tied.**
[**The only way I can fight back is with grassroots support from people like you. So please, Peter, will you chip in $5 today to help me flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9855?amount=5&t=8&akid=1182%2E124072%2EnMtHqx)

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Hey folks,
Some days on the campaign trail feel like the best days of my life, full of energy, purpose, and people who make me believe in what’s possible.
Other days are a sharp reminder of what’s at stake if we don’t flip Michigan’s 10th. Some days are so hard that, when I see the damage that corruption in D.C. has on our communities, it makes my heart heavy.
But then David, my husband, looks at our team and brings everything back into rhythm.
We met in the University of Michigan’s Marching Band—he was the drum major and I was a tuba player, and somehow he’s been keeping my heart on beat ever since.
If you’re feeling disheartened about where our country is headed, chip in $30 today>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q2?refcode=x_260427_foreverdrummajor_act&amount=30]

David has held me through the hardest times in my life—like when my mom passed away while I was pregnant with our middle son, Will.
He supported me through my vital, but heavy, work as a Special Victims Prosecutor, advocating for justice for survivors of sexual assault, human trafficking, and child abuse.
And now, it’s David’s support that’s helped push me to lead the charge and fight to take back the U.S. House and fight for working families like ours.
David and I have never once been on opposing sides—except when the tubas played against the other instruments in flag football. Even then, he didn’t believe me when I played it cool and cheered against him. He was always Team Christina and fighting for our team.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: It is still hard to believe…
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2449%2E135344%2EM5OoIT)

It still is, frankly, a situation I never thought I’d find myself in...
In the early 2000s, I was recruited into the CIA and served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting U.S. forces and plotting against the homeland.
If you had told me that twenty years later the President of the United States would be calling for me to be investigated, arrested, and hanged -- and that his FBI and Department of Justice would be following up on his anger, I would have said you were out of your mind.
But that's what we've had to go through for the past several months.
All because, sadly, we have a President of the United States who believes in weaponizing the federal government against his perceived enemies and does not believe laws apply to him or his Cabinet. He uses legal harassment as an intimidation tactic to scare people out of speaking up. He’s done it to law firms, universities, private sector companies, politicians, and private individuals.
And he tried it with me.
It didn't work.
It didn't work because we fought back -- and it didn't work because a group of regular Americans sitting on a grand jury looked at this and said: No. This is not a crime.
I’ve seen authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night. As Americans, we understand the threat this poses to our democracy.
And you probably understand that we need to fight back -- sometimes legally, but also politically.
[**With that in mind, can you make a donation to help us raise the resources I need to help elect Democrats here in Michigan, and in states across the country where I'm being asked to help come and campaign for Democrats in tough races.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4030?c0=donate-today.mhEf2a&refcode=em260426-akb&t=2&akid=2449%2E135344%2EM5OoIT)**

| | | | | | Peter,

**Tomorrow, the Senate Judiciary Committee will likely vote on House Bill 1793, and the future of real safety on New Hampshire college campuses hangs in the balance.**

Rumors circulating inside the Capitol say some Senators plan to weaken the bill with amendments that would destroy its effectiveness.

**We cannot let that happen.**

This might be our final opportunity to keep the bill strong and get it over the finish line as written.

HB 1793 prohibits public colleges and universities from banning the possession or carrying of firearms and non-lethal self-defense tools on campus.

**It ends the failed policy of gun-free zones that have left students, faculty, staff, and visitors completely vulnerable.**

Sponsored by Pledge Champion Representative Sam Farrington, this bill gives law-abiding adults the constitutional right to protect themselves where they learn, live, and work.

Your calls and emails have already moved the needle. Now we must flood the committee one last time.

**Contact these members of the Senate Judiciary Committee today and demand they pass HB 1793 out of committee exactly as written with no weakening amendments:**
**📧 Sen. Bill Gannon –** [William.Gannon@gc.nh.gov](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=786961cf59&e=8c8e704ee6)

Disarming law-abiding citizens only makes criminals bolder. HB 1793 corrects this dangerous mistake and gives college communities the same right to self-defense that Granite Staters enjoy everywhere else in the state.

**That’s why we need you to make your voice heard today!**

➡️ Tell the Senate Judiciary Committee you support HB 1793 in its original form.

| Friends-
As we await the governor's decision on the Affordable Medicine Act, we want to hear from YOU!
The Affordable Medicine Act would begin saving hundreds of thousands of Virginians millions of dollars on January 1, 2027. The legislation models its [first-in-the-nation](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015csQ1wAhf1Lp1SUXa5aC27yPvRn4VX2UNHWR5KmZz0QxPMONgWInxFw7079wOIjzatVBYCIkyYzX9fY6sWpJBGmOX6gEWgXHhxhBDsdmzLmmUYuVmzjVjx93YBdyjxBiiun30QoAC0n6dJDGdIETEVRLTzouLJr9habF6beX48-jRKLgXqKsH4gs677qCO7cYMNOuEVC9Kti_Nbmr6WLWTKkkmyDAE0l2faItb7wT6Y=&c=rAXlqR113IRedGpDLSZY1ow_LkNYVqV20lqJ_bLyNjtGNR3LTeD1Xg==&ch=KN5bLMk4IVdWue1W6dkQfmphlonVEnbg0IjM-FuUZCVonrUe-e-TRw==) approach on the federal Medicare-negotiated prices that are already in effect and have been adopted - and expanded- by both the Biden and Trump administrations. The Act uses existing state authority to draw down the negotiated Maximum Fair Prices (MFPs) to hundreds of thousands of Virginians, maximizing efficiency and minimizing fiscal impact to the Commonwealth.
Has the cost of prescription drugs negatively affected you? How would the Affordable Medicine Act improve your life and your family's lives? Sharing these stories with legislators and the public is a huge part of how we raise awareness and affect change. You can use the form below, email us at info@freedomva.org, or DM us on social media!

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

For years, Americans were told to trust the system.

Stay invested.
Ride out volatility.
Think long term.

And for a while... that worked.

But today, the landscape looks very different.

Inflation is still eating into savings.
Markets are more volatile than ever.
And most retirement accounts are still heavily tied to the same assets:

Stocks.
Bonds.
Dollar-based funds.

That's not true diversification.

That's exposure to a single system.

And when that system shakes, so does your retirement.

That's why more investors are starting to ask a different question:

"How do I protect what I've built?"

One answer gaining attention is physical gold and silver.

Not paper assets.
Not ETFs.

But real, tangible metals held inside a tax-advantaged retirement account.

It's called a Gold IRA.

And it allows you to diversify a portion of your retirement outside traditional markets.

To help explain how this works, Anthem Gold Group created a free guide that walks through everything step by step.

Including:
* How to move funds from an IRA or 401(k)
* How metals are stored and insured
* Why many investors are adding gold to their portfolios
* What to consider before making a move

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
Our government should be accountable to us. Our tax dollars should go toward the things our families actually need like safe housing, healthcare, education, and strong local communities. Our leaders should be focused on improving the lives of the people they represent, not advancing agendas that pull resources away from our communities.
That’s why what we need you to donate so we can reach every voter to tell them about Chris Rabb, a candidate that stands with our communities. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/api-pa-votes-1?refcode=email04.24.2026]
https://www.instagram.com/p/DXfe20hj9pi/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DXfe20hj9pi/]
It was recently revealed that his opponent Ala Stanford has taken money from AIPAC [https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/aipac-udp-ala-stanford-philadelphia-congress-race] , a powerful lobbying group that pushes for continued U.S. military support to Israel, including sending weapons that fuel ongoing violence abroad.
More and more Americans are saying clearly: we don’t want to be stuck funding forever wars. We want our resources invested here at home, in the people and communities that make this country what it is.
Our communities deserve representation that is going to put us first, that’s why we’re supporting Chris Rabb for Congress. [https://www.instagram.com/p/DXfe20hj9pi/]
Chris Rabb has shown, time and again, that he stands with the people of Philadelphia. He stood with Chinatown when billionaires threatened our community with predatory development. He has been clear and consistent in opposing genocide and advocating for justice. As a member of the Pennsylvania State house Rabb introduced legislation to fully fund public schools and expand access to affordable housing.
We trust him because he has already shown us who he is.
But winning this race will take all of us.
We’re talking with voters across the district — having real conversations about what’s at stake and why this election matters. And we need your help to make sure we can reach everyone.
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/api-pa-votes-1?refcode=email04.24.2026]
Call voters on April 28th [https://secure.ngpvan.com/f2fdnzun8kq9LoI9fagA1A2?contactdata=tZfCPf7ncfuj1oEWexqX20qFuuBmvbMWRza/vMPwxlYygrrbVCvl0orBPG8Iy5uw1FPy5TtT43khvpQ9xgjjGLfXWcc0Q9XUH636WVQQxg7OFzeK0HSCV7/nIV8BKWMr2IdzTuSvBvS/Xiy4L4H8TNfx1MxFxDp7kU1qnnWRHmQ=]
Knock Doors on May 2nd [https://secure.ngpvan.com/vA_1mzvtgUi3RZKAPcylSQ2?contactdata=tZfCPf7ncfuj1oEWexqX20qFuuBmvbMWRza/vMPwxlYygrrbVCvl0orBPG8Iy5uw1FPy5TtT43khvpQ9xgjjGLfXWcc0Q9XUH636WVQQxg7OFzeK0HSCV7/nIV8BKWMr2IdzTuSvBvS/Xiy4L4H8TNfx1MxFxDp7kU1qnnWRHmQ=]
This is about the kind of future we want to build where our communities are heard, respected, and represented by leaders who truly stand with us.
In Solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri
Executive Director

It’s
Jocelyn.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4322?t=1001&akid=1609%2E181023%2EVdbidG ]Before I continue, will you please step up today
and make your first contribution to our campaign ahead of
our end-of-month deadline on Thursday?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4322?t=1002&akid=1609%2E181023%2EVdbidG ]Donate

I’m
running for governor because I learned early on that doing the right thing
even when it’s hard is what makes a good leader.

And right now, with the chaos and confusion coming out of Washington, we
need strong leaders at the state level who are willing and ready to do the
right thing.

As Secretary of State, I’ve learned that standing up to powerful people
often comes with pressure, criticism, and even threats. When people tried
to interfere in our elections and overturn the will of the voters, I stood
firm. Not because it was easy — but because it was right.

I stood up. I told the truth. I protected your vote.

And I'm ready to do that as your governor.

Because that's who we are as Michiganders. We stand up to bullies. We
don't back down. And we don't let anyone take our voices away.

Because leadership isn’t about what’s easy — it’s about doing what’s
right, even when there’s pressure not to. That’s especially true right
now.

Michigan needs a governor who will stand up for people and won’t back down
when it matters most.

But I’ll be honest, this race is already
competitive. Outside money is pouring in, and the attacks are only going
to grow. The only way we can keep up is if we build a campaign strong
enough to compete from the start.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/4323?t=1003&akid=1609%2E181023%2EVdbidG ]That’s why this end-of-month deadline matters. So I’m asking: Will you
make your first
contribution?

Thank you,

Jocelyn

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
AP: Trump casts Florida mail ballot as he pushes Congress to severely limit that voting option [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=042726_1&amount=25]
Team: Donald Trump voted by mail. No, we're not referring to his well-documented past usage of the practice.
No, after years of attacking vote-by-mail, countless late-night Truth Social rants, and several executive orders within the last year trying to end, or at least curtail, mail-in voting, Donald Trump voted by mail last month, in a Florida special election held on March 24, 2026 . He could have gone to an early voting site when he was at Mar-A-Lago the week before the election, but he chose to submit a mailed ballot instead, according to Palm Beach County voter records.
To be honest, we here at Voter Action Project are glad he did. We believe every eligible American deserves to vote in the manner that is easiest for them to participate. That's because we believe that the act of participation is the most important part, not what method you use to cast your ballot.
It's worth noting, however, how he's very willing to use this tool to help himself and make his own voice heard, but he wants to restrict it for everyone else if it seems like it might not benefit him. The pattern is completely clear, and his self-interest drives every decision and statement he makes about voting.
So next time you run into that anti-voting family member, friend, or neighbor, just let them know: Trump himself chose to skip voting in person while in Florida and voted by mail in 2026.
Onward,
The Voter Action Project Team

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE************** Contact: info@bofrench.com April 27, 2026 ******Bo French Uncovers Dangerous Ties Between Jim Wright and a Muslim Government** Wright has supported a Saudi-owned plant at the center of Corpus Christi’s Water Crisis
FORT WORTH, TX - On Monday, Bo French announced that he has uncovered ties between Railroad Commissioner Jim Wright and an official auxiliary of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) is the joint owner of a Corpus Christi-area plastics plant called Gulf Coast Growth Ventures (GCGV), to which Jim has close ties.
Corpus Christi is facing an historic water crisis. Corpus’s City Council guaranteed the Saudi-owned plant's use of 25 million gallons per day of the municipal water supply. The plant is also exempt from most water rationing measures.
The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its auxiliaries like SABIC operate according to “the kingdom laws and regulations that are driven from Islamic values and laws (Sharia)”. SABIC has been accused by a Delaware court of attempting to implement Sharia-derived business practices in America and has been the target of investigation by anti-Iran watchdog United Against a Nuclear Iran for its dealings with the Iranian regime.
During Jim Wright’s tenure, the Railroad Commission approved several permits allowing SABIC to operate its GCGV plant. Jim has also toured the plant, appearing in front of an Arabic-text banner representing SABIC. At the conclusion of the meeting, SABIC praised him for his actions.
**Bo French issued the following statement:**
“Despite serving on the Railroad Commission and being the only statewide elected official from Corpus Christi, Jim Wright has not only stood silent while a pro-sharia, foreign, Muslim government created the biggest looming water crisis in Texas history in his own backyard. It’s worse than that. He allowed their RRC permits to be renewed year by year, and even visited their facility, where they praised him. If Jim Wright can’t put his own neighbors before a Muslim government, he is unfit to serve in public office.”
Polls show Republican voters are deeply concerned with the growing influence of Islam in Texas. Wright has denied these concerns, saying there is “no Islamic invasion,” despite the direct ties to SABIC.

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

I’ll be the first to admit, I'm not your typical candidate.
You might actually recognize me from TV — and no, not from a campaign ad.
In December 2023, I walked onto the Jeopardy! Champions Wildcard stage as a Marine Corps Intelligence Officer stationed in Stuttgart, Germany. Heading into Final Jeopardy, I had a lead, a category I liked, and a decision to make.
I bet everything...
... and I was right.

That's how I approach most things in life. You do your homework, you back your judgment, and you don't flinch when the stakes are high.
Right now, the stakes couldn't be higher — and I'm asking you to back me as I take on my next challenge: Running for Congress.
My name is Tyler Vandenberg, and I'm a Democrat running for Congress in California's 6th District. I'm a Harvard Kennedy School graduate, a former Marine officer, and a proud Californian who has spent his career serving this country and our democracy. Now, I’m coming home to fight for it.
Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today to my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to help us WIN? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vandenberg]
DONATE TODAY TO HELP WIN THIS RACE! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vandenberg]
I didn't come to this decision lightly. After the 2024 election, I watched MAGA Extremists launch attack after attack on everything I love about this state and this country. Cuts to wildland firefighters. Slashing Medicaid. Threatening to sell off our National Forests. Gutting the agencies that keep our communities safe and our air and water clean.
And then there's Kevin Kiley — my opponent, the man currently occupying this seat.
Kiley has recently tried to rebrand himself as an "independent."
Don't believe it for a second.
Kevin Kiley votes with Donald Trump virtually every single time. The independent label is a costume he's trying on because he knows his record is a liability. He's not independent. He's MAGA with crafty branding.
California's 6th deserves better. And I intend to deliver it.
Here's what I'm going to fight for when I get to Congress:
I'm going to fight to make California affordable again. Housing costs are crushing working families across this district. I'll push for real solutions — more housing supply, stronger tenant protections, and federal investment in the infrastructure that makes communities livable. The cost of living isn't a talking point to me. I worked two restaurant jobs just to make rent when I was starting out. I know what it means to hustle just to get by.
I'm going to fight to protect our public lands and our environment. The GOP wants to sell off our National Forests. I want to protect them, fund them, and keep them accessible to every Californian — not just the wealthy few who can afford what comes after privatization. California's wilderness is not for sale.
I'm going to fight to defend Social Security and Medicare. These aren't government handouts — they're promises this country made to working people. I'll oppose any effort to cut, privatize, or undermine them, full stop.
I'm going to fight to protect our neighbors. Immigrants, women, and LGBTQ+ Californians are under assault from this administration. That ends when we flip this seat.
And I'm going to hold MAGA accountable. Not just with speeches — with votes, with investigations, with every tool available to a Member of Congress. The era of consequence-free MAGA corruption has to end somewhere. It can end here.
I spent years in the Marine Corps learning that servant leadership isn't a slogan — it's a discipline. It means showing up, doing the hard work, and putting the people you serve ahead of yourself. That's the kind of congressman I intend to be.
I'm not coming to Washington to build a brand or further my own career.
I'm coming to do the job.
But I need your help to get there. Races like this one don't flip themselves. They flip because people like you decide early that it's worth fighting for — and put their money where their values are.
So, can I count on you to chip in to my campaign TODAY? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vandenberg]
CHIP IN TO HELP DEMS RETAKE THE HOUSE! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vandenberg]
Every dollar goes directly toward building the campaign that beats Kevin Kiley and sends California's 6th a representative who actually works for them.
Let's get to work.
— Tyler Vandenberg

Peter —
Fewer people have been donating to our campaign this month. It’s our job to make the case that this fight is worth your donation.
So we want to talk about some common myths about this race in case this is what is holding you back.
**Myth 1:** “A Democrat cannot win statewide in Texas.”
**Fact:** Multiple public polls show James leading both of our potential opponents by 1-2 points. Texans know Paxton and Cornyn are two of the most corrupt politicians in the entire country, and our general election starts in a dead heat.
**Myth 2:** “It’s better to wait for the runoff to end, so we know our opponent.”
**Fact:** This is actually the time to press our advantage — to lay the groundwork for November and expand our coalition while Republicans are fighting it out and attacking each other. We need to keep introducing James to Texas voters before the dark money attacks start.
**Myth 3:** “James has already raised enough money.”
**Fact:** Texas is the most expensive competitive state in the country. There are 254 counties, 20 media markets, and 18.7 million registered voters. Everything is bigger in Texas, and it will require enormous resources to pull off this mission.
We spent down to zero in the primary. We won, but we started the general election broke. So now we are urgently trying to rebuild AND scale up.
We hope we have convinced you because James needs you more than ever.

body:
A few weeks ago, we filed one of the strongest FEC reports this campaign has ever seen
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2187%2E791427%2ET3ltq7)
Friend — We’re just going to be honest. **We’re behind.**
A few weeks ago, we filed one of the strongest FEC reports this campaign has ever seen. Thousands and thousands of donations from regular folks who believe in Ilhan and our movement, with an average contribution around $21.
But since then, our fundraising has essentially _fallen off a cliff._
We get that times are tough. Gas prices remain high, the cost of living is putting a squeeze on working families, and Trump’s disastrous budget cuts are hitting everything from healthcare to childcare to food assistance.
So we know that some people just can’t give right now. But that means we need those who can afford to chip in today to make a donation.
$5, $10, it doesn’t have to be a lot. It could be that average amount of $21. As long as tons of people do their part, it will add up to be more than enough to take on the corporate interests and powerful Super PACs who want to take Ilhan down.

Friend,
The group that once took down the Klan in court just got indicted for secretly paying it.
As a black American, I know full well the darker chapters of our nation's racial past. That's why decent people across the political spectrum once admired the old Southern Poverty Law Center – the Alabama law firm that bankrupted the United Klans of America in court on behalf of the mother of a lynching victim.
_But that SPLC is long gone._
The FBI and the Department of Justice just unsealed an 11-count federal indictment against the SPLC for wire fraud, bank fraud, and conspiracy to commit money laundering.
**From 2014 to 2023, it's alleged that the SPLC secretly wired over $3 MILLION through shell companies to members of the KKK, the National Socialist Movement, the Aryan Nations-affiliated Sadistic Souls Motorcycle Club, the mob that marched in Charlottesville – and yes, even to the same United Klans chapter they once sued into oblivion.**
That's not fighting racism. That's betraying the fight.
Every dollar they wired to a Klansman was a dollar stolen from the real work of confronting the evil they claimed to oppose. Every smear they pinned on a Christian pastor, a pro-life volunteer, or a black conservative like me was built on fraud – while the actual extremists got paid behind the curtain.
**As Kentucky's Attorney General, I took down schemes like this. As a black conservative who believes every person is made in God's image, I've watched the Left's deceitful and toxic racial racket hurt the very communities it claims to help for my entire adult life.**
_I am done watching it wreck our country._
President Trump and his administration are doing the Lord's work in going after this type of shameful fraud and dismantling blatantly racist and un-American things like DEI and CRT in our schools. But they cannot finish it without reinforcements in the U.S. Senate – and Chuck Schumer has Kentucky's open seat circled in red for November.
**May 19th is nearly upon us. The Republican primary to replace retiring Senator Mitch McConnell – the race that decides who carries this fight to Washington – is just weeks away.**
President Trump has endorsed me TWICE before as I came up through Kentucky politics – including in my successful race for Attorney General. He called me a "young star" worthy of his "complete and total endorsement" and I carry that trust with me every day. But the support I'm looking for today doesn't come from any political figure at all actually.
I'm formally asking for support from YOU – a patriot who has proven over and again your commitment to the conservative cause. To our country. Not just with your words, but your generosity and your deeds.
[**Your support today will directly fuel every ad we run, every voter we reach, and every door we knock before the polls open on May 19th.**](https://eot.cameronforkentucky.com/f/a/Bcx1wjoZI6GbF0_RpmyUDQ~~/AAAHURA~/YSlpTnAHOG185YYScWoF17kla30hFSqufoshtgSihk9Lg0FqMW7qt8zDqW1RULh6DwjYE1thsrOGroROI24oH93MC5c5vvG6UipYHVoTCAGLJsz9l2EPfe5c8mRZdKDUYXVhjZG-ea0xTeCKGomfeXdwRana-eeTcmzoNiBdV_x92k3Og3jbL8AKrA_qA3ucl5snr0HIOVHaX20RxaFRJZlH7rMMYY_xpaL59o3UKmTOUgfheQ1cGEAcjD8UpAuXadHQnLQ4A30KYkIttnOa9i2hmvnovxjwssprWSMw_Qw~)
Please – don't wait. Our Senate majority and our very country are on the line.
Sincerely,Daniel Cameron

subject: I'll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you!

After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Friend!
| Friend,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

In 1998, Steve Jobs made arguably the best hire in the history of American business: Tim Cook.
The man Jobs brought on wasn't a designer or a product visionary. He was a logistics specialist recruited to clean up Apple's inventory mess. Cook had previously been director of North American fulfillment at IBM, and then vice president for corporate materials at Compaq. An impressive, if thoroughly unflashy career. Not exactly the profile of someone destined to run the world's most valuable company.
Jobs, who had returned to Apple after being forced out years earlier, needed someone who could build the operations that would manufacture and deliver his vision at scale. Cook was that person. Within months, he had transformed Apple's supply chain, closing factories, bringing in contract manufacturers, and cutting inventory from months to days.
Cook's work ethic reminds me of our Pentagon saying: _Amateurs talk strategy, experts talk logistics._
While Jobs dreamed up the products, Cook figured out how to mass-produce millions of them and get them into customers' hands.
There was nothing inevitable about any of it. Apple was a company that had nearly gone bankrupt in [1997](https://substack.com/redirect/ba9c903c-e4c3-4d2c-8df6-c72105c03d75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Tim Cook built the operational infrastructure that made sure it could never get that close to the edge again.
Last week, Cook [announced ](https://substack.com/redirect/381760d5-2e2f-448f-b3da-cbdf0308614b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)he's stepping down from the role of CEO, which he's held since 2011. He's passing the baton on to John Ternus, the current head of hardware engineering, and moving into an executive chairman role. Ternus, who is a UPenn grad, has spent virtually his entire [career](https://substack.com/redirect/de584386-6217-4ad6-b166-514c0038c63a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)- 25 of his 29 working years- at Apple.

The timing has a certain symmetry to it: Apple turned 50 in March, and Cook is 65, right at the conventional retirement age.
But to understand why this transition is historic, you have to go back to 2011.
Jobs was dying of pancreatic cancer and had named Cook as his successor.
At the time, Cook was largely unknown to the public: a plainspoken supply chain specialist who had spent his career optimizing inventory systems and negotiating manufacturing contracts. He lacked the magnetic charisma its founder had. Those were enormous shoes to fill. Jobs wasn't just the CEO. He was the brand, the taste, the creative force that had produced the Mac, the iPod, and the iPhone. He was the entire mythology of the company. Cook was the guy who talked about warehouses.
Most companies that lose a founder of Jobs's magnitude flounder. Instead, Apple flourished under Cook. What Cook built over fifteen years is one of the most remarkable runs in the history of American business.
Under Cook's leadership, Apple's stock climbed roughly 2,000 percent. Those who thought they missed out on the initial Apple boom in the previous decade enjoyed another 20x in capital gains. It's one of the great second acts in market history.
Revenues increased more than fourfold, reaching $416 billion in 2025. Market capitalization hit $4 trillion. The Apple Watch and AirPods became ubiquitous. The services business -- Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Pay, and iCloud -- grew into a [$100 billion annual revenue](https://substack.com/redirect/17d093f0-76d8-48d9-946e-7085d24a6ba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) engine that would rank among the Fortune 40 if it stood alone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae5ba6c7-da89-4c31-86c0-37a7230847a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
# Geopolitical Challenges Ahead
Over the last decade, Cook has been as much a diplomat as an executive. In Cook's new role on the board, he will continue to manage Apple's foreign policy, which is in a delicate position.
As far back as [2017](https://substack.com/redirect/62902ed6-9f37-46b6-94e2-d42fbfab394c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Cook began shifting iPhone production to India -- years before tariffs made it urgent -- and gradually moved other hardware lines to [Vietnam](https://substack.com/redirect/3d3aa713-0e58-4947-bffc-8c3ba0cca83d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). By 2025, roughly half of iPhones sold in the US were being made in India. He accomplished this without provoking Beijing into the kind of retaliation it has leveled at other foreign tech companies. Google pulled out of China entirely in [2010](https://substack.com/redirect/eeaa8190-fc90-4c92-9400-a557af8c1e64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after refusing censorship demands and experiencing state-sponsored cyberattacks. Cook watched that happen and made a different calculation.
When Trump imposed tariffs that threatened to make the iPhone significantly more expensive overnight, Cook didn't fight it publicly or hire an army of lobbyists. He flew to Washington, cultivated the relationship personally, and secured an exemption.
In China, Cook walked an even narrower line. He complied with censorship demands, made investment commitments, showed up at Chinese government forums, and kept Beijing just satisfied enough to avoid the kind of crackdown it has leveled against other foreign tech companies operating there. It worked: Apple reported record quarterly revenue in China as recently as January, even as US-China relations deteriorated around it.
This is why Cook is staying on the board. The geopolitical infrastructure he built over fifteen years doesn't transfer easily to a new CEO.
And yet, despite all of it, the company still faces deep structural exposure.
Apple makes an estimated [80 percent of its iPhones in China](https://substack.com/redirect/d2ca30df-c051-4827-b3dc-ab4d4857d7ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which also accounts for [roughly fifteen percent of its annual revenue](https://substack.com/redirect/1b60c797-fa96-4d35-b743-5f545a7d5eae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Those numbers are the result of deliberate choices Cook made over years to optimize for cost and scale. It also created a vulnerability that no operations expert can fully engineer away.
Because of this, Apple faces several geopolitical risks. The US-China relationship is deteriorating. And then there's Taiwan, which sits at the center of a potential military confrontation that would strand Apple's entire product line overnight.
Every iPhone, Mac, and iPad runs on chips that only one company on earth can manufacture at the required level of sophistication: TSMC, headquartered in Taiwan, 100 miles from the Chinese mainland. TSMC controls roughly 70 percent of the global semiconductor foundry market, and there is no real alternative.
Now, imagine a nightmare scenario. China decides to make good on its long-standing claim that Taiwan is not a sovereign nation but a rogue province that will, one way or another, be reunited with the mainland. If China blockades the island, it sets off a devastating chain reaction.
TSMC's chairman has said publicly that in a conflict scenario, the fabs become inoperable because the global supply chain of chemicals, equipment, and expertise that keeps them running collapses around them. If the chips stop, every factory assembling Apple products goes dark.
The stores have nothing new to sell. The services revenue that Cook spent fifteen years building holds for a quarter, maybe two, before the installed base starts to erode. The stock, which Cook built to $4 trillion, craters in a way that no buyback program can arrest.
This is what the new CEO is walking into.
When President Trump sits down with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing on May 14th, the agenda will be dense: trade tensions that have pushed [effective tariff rates on Chinese goods](https://substack.com/redirect/15a38105-6106-4d63-9a98-cccc99b01147?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) above 30%, a [$202 billion trade deficit](https://substack.com/redirect/32730ffe-cba2-4954-9857-682838955243?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), over [90,000 manufacturing jobs lost in 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/0f7692ce-50f6-4364-b329-d7dfa75094e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and competing interests in Venezuela and Iran all on the table.
The road ahead for John Ternus is uncertain in ways that Cook's never was. Cook inherited a company with the iPhone launched as a game-changing category innovation. Ternus inherits a company that hasn't redefined a category in years, that is behind on AI, that faces an antitrust trial threatening its most profitable business, and that sits at the center of a geopolitical fault line that no executive, however skilled, can fully control.
To succeed, Ternus will need to be something Cook never had to be: simultaneously a product visionary, a seasoned operator, and a geopolitical diplomat navigating two superpowers that are running out of patience with each other.
Apple has survived near-total collapse before and proved the doubters wrong every time. Whether it can do so again in a fracturing global order with China as both its biggest opportunity and its greatest vulnerability is the question that will define the next decade.

Despite the 22nd Amendment — which has limited presidents to two terms since 1951 — House GOP members are pushing legislation that would open the door to keeping Trump in power even longer. This is exactly the kind of power grab that EMILYs List was built to fight back against. We put together a quick survey, and we want to hear from you: | Your voice matters — not just as a data point, but because what our community thinks shapes how we fight back.
