clean_body: AI data centers in the news Peter, Friend, Two big news items recently broke on data centers. Here's what they mean. We finally know the price tag: $2 billion. The Legislative Fiscal Bureau confirmed that Wisconsin's 2023 data center sales tax exemption will , plus $369 million every year after. That money could be funding schools, roads, and child care, but instead it’s going instead to Microsoft, Meta, and Vantage. The same day, the Public Service Commission that Big Tech has to pay for the power plants running their own data centers. That's a meaningful protection, and it happened because thousands of Wisconsinites flooded the PSC with comments and refused to be quiet. The movement is working. But we're not out of the woods. We Energies is still pushing a 9.2% rate hike over the next two years. New dirty energy is being built across this state — gas plants, generators — to power data centers, with the climate costs borne by all of us and the electricity going to none of us. That's why this race matters. The most recent Marquette Law School Poll found 70% of Wisconsinites say data centers cost more than they're worth, and opposition has surged across party lines. Even Tom Tiffany has jumped on the bandwagon, announcing this month that he'd end data center subsidies as governor. Yes, the same guy who's taken about $11,500 from the PAC tied to We Energies and voted to slash funding for the Citizens Utility Board, the ratepayer advocates who helped win Friday's ruling. He didn't have a problem with corporate handouts before the polls moved. And let's be serious here: Once the cameras are off and his donors come calling, he'll change his mind right back. I've been leading on this issue since day one. In January, I introduced , the most comprehensive AI data center policy plan in this race. I'm calling for a moratorium on new construction, an end to tax breaks for Big Tech, and public ownership of new energy infrastructure. We have more AI policy in the works, and we'll be sharing later this week — watch this space for more! ) In solidarity, Fran Email us: mailto:info@francescahong.com

### **Trump Didn 't Just Break Politics--He Broke Truth**
Imagine living the tortured, self-loathing, charade that is Donald Trump's life. Having to create the pleasant fiction that you possess even average intelligence. That you've been a successful businessman. That people like you. That you're glamorous.
We don't have to imagine. Because it was proven yet again by whatever the hell happened at the White House Correspondent's Dinner Saturday night that we're all living in Donald Trump's demented daydreams. The constant need for drama. The finding fights everywhere with everyone. Always on edge. Scared of what the next minute may bring.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/50897569-de6d-4803-b85d-30888ee196e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Donald Trump has lied so endlessly, gaslighted so constantly, shared disinformation so effortlessly, on everything from his election loss in 2020 to winning his club golf tournaments (🤣) to "they're eating the dogs, they're eating the cats, they're eating the pets of the people that live there."
With Trump's perfidy on tap--plus algorithms deployed by his broligarch, multi-billionaire buds, FoxNews, talk radio, even once semi-reliable media now run by his predator pals--like _The Washington Post_ or _CBS News_ --does anyone feel like they can truly know the truth in the same way we all could just two years ago?
### **Get The Facilities Out (GTFO) ICE!**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a510a842-1340-4257-8140-accbf209a136?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We saw it from day one with ICE.
Families ripped apart. Babies separated from parents like America was suddenly auditioning for a dictatorship with flag pins. People snatched off streets, deported into legal black holes, violence normalized in broad daylight while blowhards argued semantics.
The America we thought was our reality, if imperfect--constitutional republic, rule of law, basic moral assumption some things are too grotesque to consider--was shot 10 times on the street in broad daylight in Minneapolis.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9194525b-1f4b-48e9-ba64-b88dcb71fc84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's why Miles Taylor of DEFIANCE.org and Steve Schmidt of The Save America Movement (SAM) joined me on _Amped Up_ to discuss their newest project, GTFO-ICE--or Get The Facilities Out, ICE. A campaign to organize local residents from communities across the country to prevent the sale of warehouses to ICE, and prevent construction from being completed if already begun.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/187d7565-2f35-4c67-9d2f-ca30fddd446b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Because the real goal is, by any means necessary, **to prevent these facilities from being transformed into actual concentration camps.** I never dreamed I would write that sentence in America.
### **First Instinct: Don 't Trust Trump **
To return to Saturday night, if we'd had a President Reagan, Ford, Bush, hell, even a Nixon, if they said someone tried to assassinate them, it wouldn't even cross my mind that didn't happen. With Trump my very first thought was "did he fake it because his polling has bottomed out worse than Kash Patel after a fistfight with Jim Beam?"
And as **" staged"** was trending across social media much of that night, it would seem I'm far from the only one to doubt the official story...because it's Trump.
Look at it this way: Trump is sinking everywhere--politically, morally, historically. His economy is a carnival ride operated by a drunk raccoon, his legal record reads like a mob boss who accidentally left his day-planner at a crime scene, and even his own allies treat him like _that guy at the wedding everyone just prays doesn 't grab the mic_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/50897569-de6d-4803-b85d-30888ee196e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And yet, for all his failures, he has achieved the ultimate dictator's goal: **he has murdered reality itself**. Because once truth is dead, everything else is negotiable. Facts can be vibes. Evidence is just new branding.
The diapered dirigible who lies like most people breathe gets a very strong say in what is _real_ simply by repeating it louder and more often than everyone else.
What do we know about what _really_ happened? A gunman reportedly stormed security with a shotgun, Secret Service tackled him, a federal agent was shot in his bulletproof vest, and Trump was rushed out. Federal prosecutors have now charged the suspect with the attempted assassination of the president. But, again, here's the problem: Trump is such a compulsive liar, such a career con man, such a convicted fraudster--with his fingerprints all over everything from January 6th to the Epstein files--nobody knows what to believe.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/50897569-de6d-4803-b85d-30888ee196e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's not because _we 're_ crazy. It's because _he_ is. And we're stuck living in that cavernous, cretinous, crater of cock-up and cacophony called Trump's cranium right now.
Trump's turned public life into what I call _a distraction Ponzi scheme_ --every bit of bad news requires another manufactured news event even bigger to obscure it. If you appear more times in the Epstein Files than Jesus in the Bible? Start a war with Iran! If your war in Iran is predictably a disaster? Fire Pam Bondi! And on and on we go.
Eventually the entire country's trapped in a pyramid of bullshit and nobody knows where the foundation is anymore.
Trump is a man who tried to overturn an election he lost, incited January 6th, and according to prosecutors and witnesses, operated like a cheap authoritarian thug buying loyalty by the pound. He lies about things that are literally on tape. He lies when there's no reason to lie. He lies the way sharks swim--because it is just his way.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/50897569-de6d-4803-b85d-30888ee196e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Yes, folks, the "Militarily Top Secret Ballroom" is so top secret **Trump just told you everything about it**. And it would've stopped a shooter! So Trump will travel everywhere in the Militarily Top Secret Ballroom? Will it be like one of those houses on wheels you see on the highway?_
* * *
Trump's own biographer has said Trump "creates his own reality," bending truth to fit whatever protects him in the moment. And once you understand that, you get the real danger: it's not just corruption, it's epistemological terrorism. He doesn't merely want power--he wants to destroy a shared understanding of what power is accountable to.
Trump's greatest achievement as a would-be dictator hasn't been January 6 or the pardons or the grift. It's been convincing millions of people that objective truth itself is multiple choice. That's how democracies die--not only when the strongman grabs power, but when people can no longer tell whether the fire is real because the arsonist has spent ten years insisting smoke has a liberal bias.
It's the part corporate media still refuses to confront. Trump isn't just another corrupt politician, another scandal machine, or another loud authoritarian with woefully inadequate hair and worse instincts. He is the culmination of a decades-long right wing project to destroy shared truth so thoroughly that accountability itself becomes impossible.
**[That's why independent media matters right now more than ever](https://substack.com/redirect/50897569-de6d-4803-b85d-30888ee196e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckMFqMyEUhZ_G2WXQq79OFi5-GmaX0kWhS3H03ozExKCm0759SegTdHnOB-fA93F0R59yup5e_QVt7eRiia6tpXSs5AO2sPp6wtZC6ffmgIPecbUD467ZiSHaGKIXYUArjDFSigmmYbURCGFRmjSYaVHLXi04-T0JHSGS8kOyjymuwIAUhutRLVoikVCGCwj_kCnuM9Y-Vrzdl5yCv3bfzlRqwDGUy5Dt2vutMfmfwcxg3rZt_K5fvZ4fmMHsiVxgci5EWF2KTB4ANDcM9AM9C7FX029u94XJw_vby1BtvG0p59S0YYqfLj7l52X_g6FPCz8BAAD__-CIc78)

Dinner Shooter Faces Federal Charges

Cole Allen, 31, a Torrance, California schoolteacher, [appeared in court](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0bGO2zAMBuCnsTcGtuxY6eChS7br2tFgJMrWHS0aFH15_SJpn6AbgR_gD3z_74_lAzPnsv7CnWa1tESJS91EjDRhoBo21JVqDWJnXVznJuhGcH4pvPRtnGOI2IeW5t57Pwz9zd3abb6ma5oGP9CtG32f-tuE1_Ex9XT7keI4pDbPr1fd6Lwbet9Nl_ExDZRSP_qud-FKzdghk9pF6TgfnAMWw_qVRANdguwtz5vZUZvhZ-Pujbs_PxlfQePuhZ61cXeWgNy4exAmsE12rIDMVCAXCHKqQQzw3LIRbHJWgiCqVA8pkYpViLkUUnhz5LKCvSjeV5SCHMH03A_AuOeSqylalgIBOSfRkhGMMGykgKqY17JTMUgUSZHhHywcWVUAdaf4arL1LPBAZhXZwTB8MUX4zpHkHVdIWSnC5xlX-jsFvChbnePxzMy5Tr4Zu3XHzG8o-49dv2f3JwAA__-aZbs1) Monday in Washington, D.C., charged with attempting to assassinate the president, transporting a firearm for use in a felony, and discharging a weapon during a violent crime.Allen breached a security perimeter Saturday at the Washington Hilton during the annual White House Correspondents' Dinner, where President Trump and Vice President Vance attended. One Secret Service agent was shot in the vest and not seriously injured. Trump and Vance were [rushed from the room](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1u7CAUBOCnwR0WHDDsFhS3cbe3TWnxc2yjsGABjvP4kfMI6aYYfRrNx2t52Zhi3v7bN5ra1yWUsLS9lI51tR6b323dsDVf-tkWYKAokxT0ktPCh2CCD5b7AQ3XWgvBH_AYdiMmxafJOaGVck-nn9Iz5ZiT4ACt10M0N8UkaBBcMzVKpwSuK5eacfATEslswtrHisfpUvQ2d9s-11I9jr68h2T23o9GxD8CM4H5uq4xH3UsdSMw3zqBmck7awJz_qaN0-nBGNfTXd9jR7qXsyH1pVZsR8kBc280xJyxUl8SUpsSZrpiwGoT9eWsfagmHFdMKTaliWTb28b0O6n_4cEvAz8BAAD___WWfu4) as shots rang out.The attack has intensified calls to fund the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), now deep into a partial shutdown, with Secret Service agents [still going unpaid](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDFuxCAURE-DOyzALDgFRRp3mzalxX4-NgoLFuAlx4-8R0g3xWhG733f17sNMaTtyz7RlOZXl91a95wbFm8BK-y2bFgr5HbWVTChKJNU6DXFlQ_OOHCWw4CGa62nic9iHnbj0eOsPrRWkntkwB-zus3eTjfNgEscgrmmmBRaTFwzNcqHmtB7LjXjAm5IJLMRSxsLHucjBrCp2frjcwEcIT-HaPbWjkqmTyIWIpbe--jzr0zY61UgYrkiEUtFKNhoxfIKgLS2ECM902GDo3U_m8s90b6DpS6khIW--UPahmLc0UOMoSpNJNueNsT3efuHq5cRfwEAAP__Lfd72w) as Democrats block multiple Republican-backed funding proposals.★★★
Supreme Court Clears Texas Map

The Supreme Court on Monday [reversed the injunction](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1yhCAUhZ8GOxy4IuwWFGnsNm1KB-GqTEAcfmIeP-M-QrpbfHPPOd_Xa34ZH_yxfZqIOtd1dsnNZU-pYl6NxWJ3kzcsxabaygwMJGWCgpqPMPPOaWed4bZDzZVSw8Af8Oh2DaMRMFowOC4S-CiF5HIQz5EpYe3w7Ly-XzEBCgaumOzFIgdcVy4U42BHJIKZgLn2Gc-2BG_NUU35XlO22NsUu6D3Ws9Chg8CE4Hpuq6-4q8pNfulHdinvBGY7hgCExP3rQhMb4ZmdP4mbfXHRqM5aW63B9oKLe3MGJHa1HKl7dwxOPpeHr2rmGMhMHVZu_PyIfgiFRFsi8aHd7H6D48_Gv4CAAD__3yFgdI) blocking Texas's redrawn congressional map, permanently clearing the lines for use in the 2026 midterms and completing a 6-3 decision issued earlier this year.The ruling solidifies Plan C2333, Texas's mid-decade redistricting plan, which [could deliver Republicans](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFu9CAQhJ8Gd1iw5of7C4o07i5tSmtvWdso2FiAz8rbR5e8QdrRaObT93Gf7hhT3Jd33NiXNk8hh6muOTcuMxJXWrEsXCvldtYJFFipjAQ37WnSXfCBAmrq2Gvn3DDoG9y61aMbiP5zwPmmLBunwdoHGTtoRB0IuuhfU8qAg0E7ZXvzsAPPszZOaaB_LIzCxKX1hY_zkSLh3rB-zrkQ95S3Lvm1taOK4U3AKGC8rqtvKy_Y-MKv49xDbK-igPF1JWBURsC4Ya3xyfKKu1zyIet5FN5YUj5Lk4WfXCpXmfLF5TcUMHbFh-OKKcVqnTBq2TCmH4r2B2lPD98BAAD__w_ffaU) as many as five additional House seats. The decision ends the legal battle over the state's effort to redraw congressional lines after the 2020 census.The structural win is a decisive piece of the Republican Party's bid to [hold the House](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDGOpTAQRE9jMiO78cckDjYh-5tuiJp2A9YajGwz_OOPmCNMVlJJVU_v33t6Y4jhWP_izi7XZfLJT2VLqXJekLjQhnnlUijVq0ygoJfKSLDTESfdeOfJo6aGnbbWdp0eYGg2xwv11g8aLGtm682rh3km1fWkFeLQBPdMKQMWOm1V35q573hZtLFKA71YGIWRc20zn9ccA-FRsfxfUiZuKe1NdFutZxHdHwGjgPG-7xY_IZWnFTDGRBgFjAUPiUdNR0gCxudVwKjMk62AsfIHi8zsQ6k5UA3HKnc8Zb4eLbJcZ-adJaUr1yY7f94hxlB6K4xadwzxB6b-wt2Xg-8AAAD__7xFfuA) majority in November 2026, giving Republicans a foundational edge as the mid-decade redistricting battle intensifies.★★★
DeSantis Drops Redistricting Map

Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis unveiled a proposed congressional map Monday that would flip [four Democratic seats](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2upiAQQJ9GOwzgD34FxTZ2d9stzQiDkkXGMPh5H3_z7SPc-iQnJ-fP1_oFMcW8_4YTbalh9eRXPogqlgAO2R1QdmR2VG9etdSTkIPQZs1pVa233nlQrkWrjDF9r2Y9t4cN8zZimNzLvPTst1FJ85p7v3nQ42jQtdF-VHLQRvfKyKkbtqnHENRgpNJuxGaQkLDUruB1byk6yBX4b6DisHN0tsketV7c9L8avTR6eZ6nC_Sd8eEPb_RyUYo1Om70UigLjwy5RhZ3fmNMLDI-IiQq0YNwlPeCzJEyJHHCJR66kxd7fKPY6RL4XQuIQHcRjFC5LdZfT0wp8mSaQe4nxPQ_rP7g49vqfwEAAP__9uGG6A) to Republican, converting the state's current 20R-8D delegation to 24R-4D. DeSantis said the map "more fairly represents the makeup of Florida today."DeSantis delivered the map to lawmakers with roughly 24 hours' notice before a [special legislative session](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGu3SAMQL-GbERAuOF2YOiS7XbtGDlgElQSIuzbqH9f5S3vzW-zrKPjI_9-zS_IJR_rL9jRN05zrHGmrVbGliAghQ3aikSh8ptmo8wolZXGzUeZdRd9DBF06NBr59ww6Kd5dptXCNGNaYEfD5uGZOKYtF20eqjRxCGlLvtbpaxxZtBOjb1dxgFT0tYpbcIDhVVQsHHf8HwvJQc4GOhPqi1gH-reFb8xnySGn8JMwkzXdfUM-wkL_LsBYaYDLxJmSqW2HEGetWTO4V7dx4WZlL1n94VpGDNxy4HzscodThmR4OBMktt7P2Wox9qQSH52SULg29o1H88rl5JpdMKqdYdcPmL5G7_9683_AAAA___XP4r7) opening Tuesday, during which the Republican-controlled legislature is expected to approve the new lines.Combined with the Supreme Court's Texas ruling Monday, the two moves could [reshape the House map](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D0OnDAUBODTmO4h_7DYW7hIQ7dpU6LHswErxka2WXL8iBwh3RSjT6P59Zk_GGJI2088vC1tnV12c91zbr6sSL7SjmXztVJuV50llyPwAaSeU5xF56wjh4I6b4XWWilhpOl2-zZCkyIUL2MUyYW8E0QL14txq8FXF-xD8UFqqYTmYz8so_LrKgbNhaSXZwPH6Evriz-vJQbC1LD-XnMh31M-umj31s7K1A8mJyan-777dJY-l43J6dGZnPjwZM3klP5AFfDSb_1WhslpjbkEhxWcr5haqHClrw-xAsI3t5A2OPCEtmMDyld0gM5By9DKdZwVtnxC8S7UVgI99a5Yd94hxlBHzQa-HRjiv6XtP479Wvk3AAD__9z5iGk) by nine seats. If both survive litigation, Republicans enter November with a structural midterm advantage they didn't have in January.
Georgia Primary Voting Starts Today

Early voting opened Monday in Georgia's competitive 2026 primaries, putting Republican contests for Senate and governor directly in voters' hands. An [InsiderAdvantage poll shows](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckMGO2yAYhJ8G37AwJsY5cGikurvSJltpD-nN-g0_NioGC0isvH2VHPoAex7Np5nveh7P4LwL8wVWVKnY0UQz5iXGgsmCxqwXSDPmrGO55ZEz3lEmKJdj8GNTGWW0gUZXqBopZds2Pe-rRdmjnTpp-gP23FjdGdBCwHS0PTtOLcrKqSeKCS5520jW1WLqWrS2EZI1XB-QCAYeU6kTbrfJOw2hQP5rY9JY67hWXi2lbJm0PwgfCB_2fa_3PJX7MyV8CLhnwgcfNXjChxljmh1Q9KiLi4G-riAk_6D3WFyY6YSzC5muMRh40C25FdLjf-EJ-3P5-fv983T5Gk5f7enjl_i8Ht7furePM-FDlZTZdue9y50kgs0rOP-aWr5h9q74vwAAAP__MuqJRw) Rick Jackson leading the gubernatorial field as Senate hopefuls wrapped a Sunday debate.

★★★
House Republicans' Fundraising Edge

Battleground Republican incumbents are outraising Democratic challengers in key House seats, a [Politico analysis finds](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFu7CAQRb8Gd17NjFnwFhSvcbevTWmxMNgo2FiAs78fOU36dEe60jnS_XjOTxtT3Jf_dmNTWph99nNdc25cgnVc3WrLwrW63M46E5DqQfak5z3N2HnjnbfoOjaotR4GHGnsVnMPOKqXl487DsQWHT5Ay9EOKmgEoC6aSwWSNA2oQd3kSw0cAkoNSO7OQoJNXNqt8HG-UnR2b7Z-hlwc31zeumTW1o4qhn-CJkHTkVNs0eVrFDTt_K6CpqsiaAJ58UVrPiv3v9J-i75x2fpw7r7YWOO-9ADjA7WCrhh_vGNKsSotJCybjemn3v5w1peh7wAAAP__plB2wQ). The financial edge won't guarantee a majority, but it removes a structural vulnerability heading into what figures to be a rough midterm environment.

★★★

I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.
But I’m scared. I’m pissed. I’m motivated. And I’m 100% in.
I’m running for Senate in South Carolina to defeat Lindsey Graham and to fight for the kids no one in D.C. seems to be thinking about. So I need you with me.
We need to hit 10,000 donations before midnight to prove that this campaign can go the distance. Can I count on you to split a donation with my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]

I’m running because the issues I care about — children’s healthcare, vaccines, gun violence, public education, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare — are under direct attack right now.
And I’m running because I consider it my professional duty as a pediatrician — to give children a strong voice at the national level. Too many are comfortable on the sidelines. That won’t work for me.
We need bold leaders who aren’t afraid to fight. I am ready.
Even though the path will be hard, I know Lindsey Graham must be held accountable. He certainly doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.
That’s why I’m running for US Senate. To defeat Trump’s lapdog and fight for everyday Americans. But, I need your support today. No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

**Our side 's attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response -- on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Peter.

Hi there,
After a disappointing 2025 session, the 2026 short session was an opportunity to change course by delivering bold climate action and demonstrating that Oregon is ready to lead. Instead, too many opportunities were missed and the legislature even took steps backwards as efforts to address the ODOT budget shortfall siphoned funds dedicated away from student safety, passenger rail, and community paths.
That failure means Oregonians are still being left to shoulder the rising costs of climate disasters from wildfires and smoke-filled summers to extreme heat and drought while fossil fuel companies continue to post record profits. Policies like Climate Resilience Superfund Bill (SB 1541) could generate billions to invest in wildfire prevention, climate resilience projects and energy affordability without raising costs on everyday Oregonians.
We need leadership in Oregon that is innovative, ambitious, and willing to meet the scale of the climate crisis. Leadership that ensures polluters pay their fair share, lowers energy costs for families, and builds a future we can count on.
That’s why, in our 2025-2026 Scorecard, we made a different choice and strengthened accountability. Legislators who sponsored a Major Threat received a 5% deduction in their score for each session; meaning those who sponsored Major Threats in both 2025 and 2026 were docked twice, reflecting a continued pattern of support for policies that would move Oregon in the wrong direction.

clean_body: Read the 2025-26 Scorecard [] [] Hi there, After a disappointing 2025 session, the 2026 short session was an opportunity to change course by delivering bold climate action and demonstrating that Oregon is ready to lead. Instead, too many opportunities were missed and the legislature even took steps backwards as efforts to address the ODOT budget shortfall siphoned funds dedicated away from student safety, passenger rail, and community paths. That failure means Oregonians are still being left to shoulder the rising costs of climate disasters from wildfires and smoke-filled summers to extreme heat and drought while fossil fuel companies continue to post record profits. Policies like Climate Resilience Superfund Bill (SB 1541) could generate billions to invest in wildfire prevention, climate resilience projects and energy affordability without raising costs on everyday Oregonians. We need leadership in Oregon that is innovative, ambitious, and willing to meet the scale of the climate crisis. Leadership that ensures polluters pay their fair share, lowers energy costs for families, and builds a future we can count on. That’s why, in our 2025-2026 Scorecard, we made a different choice and strengthened accountability. Legislators who sponsored a Major Threat received a 5% deduction in their score for each session; meaning those who sponsored Major Threats in both 2025 and 2026 were docked twice, reflecting a continued pattern of support for policies that would move Oregon in the wrong direction. Take action [] OLCV’s Environmental Scorecard is one of our most powerful tools for holding lawmakers accountable and the 2025–2026 Scorecard is out now. Check to see how your legislators voted by clicking here [] . Now you, Peter, can take action to hold our legislators accountable! [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In New York’s 13th congressional district, progressive organizer and union
member Darializa Avila Chevalier is taking on Rep. Adriano Espaillat, an
out-of-touch AIPAC-backed incumbent and member of the NYC political
machine.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260427-dac.HLvvjS&refcode=em20260427-37714&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37714%2E1203867%2EcmO_QF ]The City: Challenger’s poll shows soft support for Espaillat in NY-13.
An internal campaign poll has political newcomer Darializa Avila Chevalier
gaining on Rep. Adriana Espaillat in a fast-heating contest in Upper
Manhattan and The Bronx.

While the first poll initially shows Espaillat with 42 percent support
over Darializa’s 28 percent, that drastically changed when respondents
learned more about her and what she plans to fight for in Congress — like
passing Medicare for All, abolishing ICE, and ending U.S. support for
Israel’s genocide against Palestinians.

Then, Darializa takes the lead at 46 percent!

This shows that our working-class candidate is gaining traction against a
five-term incumbent, and it makes sense: New Yorkers are hungry for
change.

We saw it last November when voters elected Zohran Mamdani for mayor over
Andrew Cuomo (who Espaillat endorsed). Now, our movement has the
opportunity to take on the establishment and win in a major upset yet
again this June!

But the only way Darializa can go up against Espaillat, AIPAC, and his
slew of corporate donors is with folks like you pitching in whatever you
can to help get out the vote between now and the June 23rd primary.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: They tried to take Trump out again
body:
Plus: Haaland is crushing Bregman by 22 points | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=b6ba034f82&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
The third attempt on President Trump's life in two years happened Saturday night. [The New York Times had nothing on its front page](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=95e005ebff&e=567664f14c) Sunday morning. People Magazine called it an "incident."
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c4170b25b5&e=567664f14c)
| |
**🔥 THE MEDIA SILENCE**
8:34 PM EST. A man with a shotgun, a handgun, and knives charged the security checkpoint at the White House Correspondents Dinner. A Secret Service agent took a round to the vest. Trump, Melania, and JD Vance were rushed off stage.
The New York Times Sunday front page had room for everything except this. We show you the headline People Magazine ran instead.
Then Dan Bongino — twelve years in the Secret Service — torches the "both sides" lie in a way that should be required viewing for every reporter who was in that ballroom.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3c65f1106e&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
**🚨 A FORMER CIA OFFICER SAYS HEADS SHOULD ROLL**
Sarah Adams was a CIA targeting officer. She knows what a security failure looks like.
We read directly from the manifesto the shooter sent to his family ten minutes before he made his move. What he wrote about how lax the security actually was — you have to hear it.
When you put his words next to Adams' analysis, the picture that comes together should terrify every American. We tell you why.

**📊 1.3 MILLION VOTERS JUST WALKED AWAY FROM DEMOCRATS**
Thirty states track voter registration by party. In twenty-eight of them, Republicans are gaining ground.
Mark walks through the numbers state by state — Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, New Mexico — and the cumulative figure is staggering.
We tie it directly to the silence, the violence, and the California governor's debate where two Democratic candidates just defended truck drivers who can't read English. Mark calls it "suicidal empathy." Wait until you hear what they actually said.

**🏛️ HAALAND CRUSHES BREGMAN BY 22 POINTS**
The Journal poll dropped Sunday. We've been telling you for months this was never going to be a race.
Haaland 52, Bregman 30. She wins women by a landslide. She wins college graduates. She wins liberals.
Bregman wins exactly one demographic. We tell you what it is — and why running as the moderate in today's Democratic Party is a campaign strategy that doesn't exist anymore.
